hosts.title_observed: GCP IAM Policy Diff Lab
hosts.notes: Fixed this session. Root cause was NOT a CNAME conflict between the two repos as previously recorded here: gcp-billing-anomaly-router's own CNAME file correctly says billing.kineticgain.com, not gcp.kineticgain.com (re-verified via GitHub's contents API). The real cause was Hostinger's /gcp document root containing a full copy of gcp-billing-anomaly-router's build (identical filenames and byte sizes), evidently deployed there by mistake at some point. DNS (an ALIAS to gcp.kineticgain.com.cdn.hstgr.net.) was already correct and distinct from billing's own ALIAS the whole time. gcp-iam-policy-diff-lab does have a working GitHub Pages config (verified, prior successful builds), but that path is unused since DNS routes to Hostinger instead, matching the lane's other members (entra, guardduty, zone, billing all work the same way: Pages config present but dormant, Hostinger is what's actually live). Fix: built gcp-iam-policy-diff-lab locally (lint/typecheck clean, 17/18 tests pass, the one failure confirmed as a local sandbox network artifact via the repo's own real CI logs), ran npm run prerender, deployed via Hostinger's own deploy API (hosting_deployStaticWebsite), which does a full clean replace, not an overlay, removing the wrong billing-shaped routes (anomaly-risks/, billing-lane/, routing-posture/) automatically. Verified live: correct title, old wrong routes now 404, new correct routes 200, billing.kineticgain.com unchanged and still correct. No repeatable CI deploy path exists yet for this repo to Hostinger; if it needs to be redeployed in the future this was a manual, one-off fix, not a wired pipeline.

well_known_conformance.method: GET each apex /.well-known/* document, compare *_version field to the spec's expected value
well_known_conformance.root_cause: The apex publishes registry-index objects (organization, url, description, a records/decisions/incidents/tutors/etc array, signature) at ad hoc paths, while each spec defines a single-document-per-entity shape with a required id and the spec's own *_version. Confirmed uniform across all 11 sampled documents as of 2026-09-12 (Phase 4 pre-check) -- 0 of 11 conform, same root cause each time, not a partial issue. Full rewrite is Phase 4 proper, requires Miz sign-off on the exact new document shape and re-signing plan before touching any signed document.
